precepts.point: The eagle, whom thou sawest come up from the sea, is the kingdom which was seen in the vision of thy brother Daniel, but it was not expounded unto him. This last kingdom Daniel never understood, nor saw the animal symbol; the angel revealed it to Esdras: it is the eagle. We are living in the United States of America; what is their symbol? The eagle. This eagle has three heads: Rome, America, Britain.

note.label: Religion - The False Prophet

precepts.why:
Ezra saw “an eagle, which had twelve feathered wings, and three heads” come up from the sea, and she “spread her wings over all the earth.” Then the angel told him: “The eagle, whom thou sawest come up from the sea, is the kingdom which was seen in the vision of thy brother Daniel. But it was not expounded unto him, therefore now I declare it unto thee.”

Go back to Daniel and see what he saw: “a fourth beast, dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly; and it had great iron teeth: it devoured and brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with the feet of it: and it was diverse from all the beasts that were before it; and it had ten horns.” Daniel saw the lion, the symbol of Babylon; the bear of the Persians and Medes; the leopard of the Greeks. But this fourth one was diverse, different from every beast before it, and Daniel never understood it and never saw its animal symbol.

What was hidden from Daniel was revealed to Ezra: the fourth kingdom is the eagle. We are living in the United States of America, and what is their symbol? The eagle. This eagle has three heads: Rome, America, Britain.

That is the same beast of Daniel 7:25 that “shall speak great words against the most High, and shall wear out the saints of the most High, and think to change times and laws.” So the fourth beast is not some kingdom long gone. It is the eagle kingdom we live under now, the one that devoured, brake in pieces and stamped the residue, and wore our people out in slavery.

“This is the interpretation of the vision: The eagle, whom thou sawest come up from the sea, is the kingdom which was seen in the vision of thy brother Daniel. But it was not expounded unto him, therefore now I declare it unto thee.” The animal symbol Daniel was not shown is the eagle, and it was only revealed to Esdras. That is why it is precept upon precept, line upon line, here a little and there a little. If you don't read the Bible that way, you are going to be confused.
